inserted_paragraph: Before consuming a checksum manifest, record its producer-defined path schema, explicit resolution base and allowed proof scope; inspect genuine first entries before adapting the consumer. A namespace-relative `EVIDENCE-SHA256SUMS` may resolve at its proof directory, while a repository-relative `SUPPORT-SHA256SUMS` resolves at the repository root. The filename or manifest location alone does not select the base. Resolve exact entries against that recorded base and enforce scope containment, no symlink components and no duplicate entries; reject absolute, traversal or ambiguous paths before hashing or launching consumers. Preserve the original failed checker and observations. Correct the consumer mapping and save derived results separately; never rewrite or normalize entries, strip/add prefixes or try alternative bases to force a pass. Manifest errors block launch and do not authorize engine execution or retries.
